description: Confirm a one-hour domain challenge with the same private requester key. Exact HTTPS origin and path must match. Returns a 90 day listing-control credential; identical retries recover that grant. A new proof revokes prior credentials. Confirmation does not approve branding or change grades. For a pending private contact, retry the original challenge_id/requester_key with contact_code. For a correction, use update_id and its private requester_key; an exact update-bound domain file queues review without publishing the proposed fields. Never signs payments.
name: confirm_ownership_proof
